title: tkchart
description: tkchart is a Python library that provides a live-updating line chart widget built on top of the tkinter framework. It lets you plot real-time data — like network speed, CPU usage, or sensor readings — directly inside a tkinter window without any external dependencies. You simply create a chart, call an update function in a loop, and the chart redraws itself smoothly as data comes in.
long-description: tkchart was born out of necessity. While building a network speed monitor using tkinter, I couldn't find any widget that could render live-updating line charts. I ended up hacking together a canvas-based solution, and then realized the community needed a proper, reusable widget. tkchart is the result — a clean, customizable line chart widget that updates in real time.
features: Multiple data series on one chart

why-i-made-this.simple: There wasn't a live updating line-chart widget for tkinter, so I decided to make one.
why-i-made-this.extended: Long time ago I was trying to create a network speed showing app using tkinter, actually it was like a task manager with network speed showing feature. But I was struggling to find a widget that can show live updating line chart. So I used the canvas widget and drew lines depending on net speed and chart height, then I realized why don't I create my own widget for that to help people out there.
